q_45241.question_text: How much will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross domestically before August 31, 2026?
q_45241.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution

The question resolves based on cumulative domestic gross through **August 30, 2026**. Today is August 9, 2026. That leaves **21 days** of theatrical performance to estimate.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

As of August 7, 2026, the film had already grossed **$553.1 million domestically** with just 8 days in theatrical release (opened July 31).

This film is tracking at an extraordinary pace:
- Fastest film ever to $400M (achieved in 5 days)
- Fastest film ever to $500M (achieved in 7 days)
- Record-breaking opening weekend of $360.1M
- Extremely strong weekday holds (Tuesday $42M, Monday $47M indicate minimal weekday drop-off)

The remaining 21 days (August 9-30) will include:
- Second weekend (Aug 9-11)
- Third weekend (Aug 16-18)
- Fourth weekend (Aug 23-25)
- Additional weekdays

**Key dynamics:**
- Historically, blockbusters of this caliber see declining per-day grosses each subsequent week, but with much softer drops than typical films
- *Avengers: Endgame* (the closest precedent for a record-breaking opening) had exceptional legs but still declined week-to-week
- Spider-Man films have historically shown strong legs in the domestic market
- 21 days of additional theatrical run is substantial runway

**Projection approach:**
From $553.1M (through Aug 7, spanning opening weekend through day 8):
- Week 2 (Aug 8-14, 7 days): Likely $80-100M (maybe 20-25% of opening week)
- Week 3 (Aug 15-21, 7 days): Likely $50-70M (assuming typical 30-40% decline from week 2)
- Week 4 (Aug 22-28, 7 days): Likely $30-45M (assuming typical 30-40% decline from week 3)
- Final 2 days (Aug 29-30): Likely $8-12M

This would suggest a range of roughly **$721M to $828M** by August 30.

However, given:
- The exceptional trajectory and minimal weekday drop-off so far
- The possibility of stronger-than-typical holds for such a phenomenon
- The global appeal and likely international support sustaining marketing through August

A more realistic estimate centers higher, around **$770-820M**.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Unexpected major competition**: A significant counter-programming film releasing Aug 16 or 23 (not mentioned in materials)
- **Market saturation or fatigue**: Though unlikely given the momentum, audiences could exhaust demand faster than historical precedents
- **Negative word-of-mouth or reviews**: Could accelerate the normal drop-off, though early reception appears positive given record-breaking performance
- **Wider theater drops**: Studios typically reduce theater counts after 2-3 weeks for blockbusters
- **Real-world disruptions**: Unforeseen events affecting theatrical attendance

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Exceptional holds**: If the film maintains 25-30% week-over-week holds (better than typical blockbusters) rather than 35-45% drops
- **Extended marketing push and word-of-mouth**: The record-breaking opening could drive sustained cultural interest
- **Limited competition in late August**: If no major releases cannibalize the audience
- **International strength translating to domestic**: Strong global performance ($706.3M international as of Aug 7) could indicate broader appeal supporting domestic legs
- **Franchise loyalty and repeat viewing**: Spider-Man's devoted fan base might support multiple viewings

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the provided materials:
- *Avengers: Endgame* (2019): $357.1M opening weekend, reached $1B global in similar timeframe but appears to have had domestic gross well above $800M based on context
- *Spider-Man: Brand New Day* opening weekend: $360.1M (largest ever)
- First week domestic: $500M+ (fastest ever to $500M)
- First 8 days (through Aug 7): $553.1M

Historical Spider-Man films and comparable MCU blockbusters typically see strong domestic legs, with final domestics often in the $750M-$950M range for exceptional performers. Given that this film is tracking above all precedent, it's likely to exceed typical Spider-Man domestic totals.

---

## Final Estimate

Given the film has already achieved $553.1M in 8 days, with 21 days remaining (nearly 2.6x the current duration), and assuming reasonable but not exceptional holds:

- Conservative scenario (steeper weekly drops): ~$720M
- Base case (typical superhero legs): ~$785M  
- Optimistic scenario (exceptional holds): ~$850M

Weighting these scenarios and the clear momentum:

Low (10th percentile): 710000000
Median (50th percentile): 800000000
High (90th percentile): 870000000

As of August 7, 2026, *Spider-Man: Brand New Day* has grossed \$553,088,528 domestically [boxofficemojo.com](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/release/rl2299756545/). The film opened on July 31, 2026, with a record-breaking \$360,091,572 domestic opening weekend [boxofficemojo.com](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/release/rl2299756545/weekly/) [hollywoodreporter.com](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-biggest-first-week-1236668259/). It achieved the highest-grossing first week in domestic box office history, surpassing \$500 million in North America in seven days, making it the fastest film to reach that milestone [hollywoodreporter.com](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-biggest-first-week-1236668259/).

Additional records include the biggest Tuesday ever with \$42,013,437 (August 4) and the highest-grossing Monday with \$47,064,608 (August 3) [variety.com](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/spider-man-brand-new-day-highest-grossing-movie-box-office-1236828413/) [boxofficemojo.com](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/release/rl2299756545/). As of August 7, the worldwide gross for the film is \$1,259,388,528, with an international gross of \$706.3 million [boxofficemojo.com](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/title/tt22084616/). The film reached the \$1 billion global mark in six days, becoming the second-fastest film to do so after *Avengers: Endgame* [hollywoodreporter.com](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-biggest-first-week-1236668259/) [variety.com](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/spider-man-brand-new-day-highest-grossing-movie-box-office-1236828413/).
